headline: Mercosur Tax Relief Drives Brazilian Oil Exports to Europe as Output Hits Record
summary: A Mercosur tax break is accelerating Brazilian crude exports to Europe. Brazil's oil production hit a record 4.7 million barrels per day in September, up 20.3% year-on-year, positioning it to add more oil than any other producer.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest oil producer, driven by expansive deepwater pre-salt fields. Increasing shipments to Europe offer refiners alternative crude supply outside of traditional Middle Eastern maritime corridors.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Brazilian crude production surged 20.3% year-on-year to a record 4.7 million b/d amid expanding European exports.
